description: This file defines a React component for displaying detailed information about a recipe, including fetching data via a loader, setting page metadata, and rendering the UI elements. It also exports an error boundary component.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Defines the page metadata, including the title and description based on the recipe data.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Fetches the recipe data by ID from parameters and raises a 404 response if not found.

methods.name: RecipeDetail
methods.description: React component that displays detailed information about a recipe, including ingredients, steps, and tags.

methods.name: ErrorBoundary
methods.description: Component that renders an error message when loading or rendering the recipe fails.
